A1.justification: Both PDFs describe MRGen and MRGen-DB. Their complete main texts, equations, tables, figures, and appendices are readable and support reliable matching across revisions.

before.justification: v2 reports original image-generation and segmentation experiments, ablations, annotation verification, and qualitative analyses in the main text and appendices.

after.justification: v3 retains these original results and adds CT-to-MRI segmentation results and preliminary volumetric generation examples.

M1.justification: The documented 2D architecture, conditioning, losses, training stages, and filtering procedure are unchanged. However, v3 introduces a 3D feasibility demonstration without explaining how the generator was adapted. Whether this entails a changed model or generation procedure cannot be reliably determined.

E1.justification: v3 substantially extends coverage beyond MRI-to-MRI transfer by evaluating AMOS22 CT to CHAOS T1/T2 and MSD-Liver CT to CHAOS T2 in Table 10. Section E.2 also adds volumetric generation, extending the evaluated task beyond individual slices. The original MRI coverage remains.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in matched experiments, including Table 9's additional baselines and oracle references. New Table 10 reuses DualNorm and source-data/CycleGAN comparisons with nnUNet and UMamba; it introduces no new comparison method.

E3.justification: The new 3D feasibility evaluation uses 256 × 256 × 16 volumes alongside the retained 512 × 512 slice experiments. Existing MRI splits, metrics, training budgets, and filtering settings are unchanged. The newly explicit test-data exclusion statement documents practice rather than establishing a revised split.

E4.justification: Section E.2 and new Figure 9 add a qualitative feasibility study addressing inter-slice consistency in volumetric generation. v2 only proposed this extension as future work. Existing reconstruction, conditioning, and filtering ablations, in-domain analyses, and Figure 8 failure cases remain.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, or variability estimates for model performance. Annotation-verification sampling and SAM2 filtering confidence thresholds are unchanged.

E6.justification: Tables 1–9 retain their numerical values. New Table 10 adds three CT-to-MRI comparisons; for example, AMOS22 CT to CHAOS T1 yields MRGen-trained nnUNet/UMamba DSC scores of 56.23/60.53. Figure 9 adds qualitative volumetric results. These supplement rather than revise earlier same-setting findings.

T1.justification: The method equations, training objectives, diffusion derivations in Appendix A, and filtering conditions in Appendix C.2 are unchanged mathematically. Encoder/decoder notation capitalization changes do not introduce new definitions, reasoning, or proofs.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same central contributions: MRGen-DB, text-and-mask-conditioned MRI synthesis, and improved segmentation for modalities lacking mask annotations. The added appendix experiments do not redefine these headline claims.

C2.justification: New Section D.3 explicitly acknowledges the difficulty of evaluating truly rare modalities with scarce ground truth and interprets CT results as supporting broader cross-protocol applicability. Section E.2 interprets the new volumetric examples as preliminary evidence of inter-slice consistency, qualified by limited computation. Existing failure limitations remain.

D1.justification: v3 explicitly states in Section 4.1 that segmentation test data are excluded from generative-model training and clarifies that each dataset sample is a 2D slice. Existing implementation settings and resource-access statements remain. Detailed implementation information for the new CT and 3D experiments is limited.

R1.justification: v3 adds the AMOS benchmark citation for the new CT experiments. TotalSegmentator-MRI, SAM2, and BiomedCLIP references are publication updates of already cited works, not new research additions. The broader positioning against prior approaches remains unchanged.

P1.justification: v3 makes localized copyedits throughout the abstract, introduction, method, and appendices, updates affiliations, and adds acknowledgments. It inserts an appendix subsection on additional modalities and renumbers the qualitative-results subsection while retaining the overall narrative structure.

P2.justification: v3 adds Table 10 and the volumetric Figure 9, adjusts display sizes and placement, and moves Table 5 between columns. Existing qualitative examples remain; v2 Figures 9–10 become v3 Figures 10–11. Caption and layout changes are localized rather than a wholesale redesign.

improvement.justification: The CT-to-MRI comparisons provide concrete support for broader applicability, while the volumetric examples move 3D extension beyond v2's purely prospective discussion. Explicit test-data exclusion also improves evaluation transparency. These are useful but limited gains: the principal results remain unchanged, and sparse implementation detail plus qualitative-only 3D validation constrain the strength of the new evidence.
